title: An integrated in-vitro, transcriptomic, and in-silico approach to understand the molecular mechanism of quorum-sensing inhibition by Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) in Chromobacterium violaceum.
authors: Sikdar, Bratati; Paul, Debarati; Banik, Suman K; Dastidar, Shubhra Ghosh; Gangopadhyay, Gaurab
one_liner_zh: 该文结合转录组学、分子对接与动力学模拟，研究EGCG抑制CviR蛋白进而影响其DNA结合的群体感应机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作建模，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系且方法深度有限。
abstract: Quorum Sensing (QS) inhibition has become a promising strategy to fight bacterial infection since it inhibits pathogenesis without killing the bacteria. The present study has explored the anti-QS and anti-biofilm activity of Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG), a major phyto-constituent of green tea. EGCG showed a significant reduction in biofilm formation, violacein, exopolysaccharide, protease production, and swarming motility in Chromobacterium violaceum ATCC 12472 at different sub-inhibitory concentrations (25-150 microg/ml). Its efficacy was checked along with an antibiotic drug, tetracycline, with reported anti-QS potential. EGCG didn't hamper the growth of the bacterium up to 75 microg/ml concentration, but inhibited QS-related factors. Transcriptomic profiling of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in EGCG and tetracycline-treated bacterial cells demonstrated that EGCG led to significant downregulation of QS-related genes, particularly those within the CviI/CviR circuit (cviI, cviR, and vioABCDE). In contrast, tetracycline exhibited a broader suppression of essential metabolic genes, reflecting its general bactericidal activity. Quantitative RT-PCR analysis validated that EGCG significantly reduced the expression of QS-related genes in C. violaceum. Our proposed pathway for EGCG-mediated QS inhibition pointed towards the EGCG's interaction with the CviR protein. Molecular docking and dynamic simulation studies predicted that EGCG binds stably to the CviR, potentially obstructing its interaction with the autoinducer and subsequent DNA binding. This study promotes EGCG as an effective QS inhibitor, which could help develop anti-bacterial medications targeting quorum sensing.
abstract_zh: 群体感应（Quorum Sensing, QS）抑制已成为对抗细菌感染的一种有前景的策略，因为它能在不杀死细菌的情况下抑制致病性。本研究探讨了绿茶主要植物成分表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯（Epigallocatechin-3-gallate, EGCG）的抗QS和抗生物膜活性。在不同亚抑制浓度（25-150微克/毫升）下，EGCG显著降低了紫色杆菌（Chromobacterium violaceum）ATCC 12472的生物膜形成、紫色杆菌素、胞外多糖、蛋白酶产生及群集运动性。其功效与具有报道抗QS潜力的抗生素药物四环素进行了比较。EGCG在高达75微克/毫升浓度下未抑制细菌生长，但抑制了QS相关因子。对EGCG和四环素处理细菌细胞中差异表达基因（DEGs）的转录组分析表明，EGCG导致QS相关基因显著下调，特别是CviI/CviR回路中的基因（cviI、cviR和vioABCDE）。相比之下，四环素对必需代谢基因表现出更广泛的抑制，反映了其普遍的杀菌活性。定量RT-PCR分析验证了EGCG显著降低了C. violaceum中QS相关基因的表达。我们提出的EGCG介导QS抑制途径指向EGCG与CviR蛋白的相互作用。分子对接和动态模拟研究预测，EGCG稳定结合CviR，可能阻碍其与自诱导物的相互作用及随后的DNA结合。本研究支持EGCG作为有效的QS抑制剂，有助于开发靶向群体感应的抗菌药物。
